name: TryFrom<pb::Event> for Event / From<&Event> for pb::Event / EventRecord conversions

test_list.description: One sample of each of the 21 sdk Event variants survives sdk -> pb -> bytes -> pb -> sdk unchanged; an exhaustive match in the test fails to compile when the sdk adds a variant.
EventRecord keeps seq, session, event and the timestamp exactly, including pre-epoch values and Timestamp::MIN / MAX.
An Event without a kind, and an EventRecord without event / session / at, give MissingField naming the field.
WorkerRestarted with worker = 0 (unspecified) or an unknown number gives UnknownVariant.
A Cid of the wrong length gives InvalidLength; schema 0, 3 and above u16::MAX are rejected; nanos outside 0..1e9 are rejected.
Default (all-empty) pb::Event and pb::EventRecord return Err.
For arbitrary sdk Events (all variants): sdk -> pb -> bytes -> pb -> sdk equals the original.
For arbitrary EventRecords: the same roundtrip is the identity.
Arbitrary bytes decoded as pb::Event / pb::EventRecord and converted give Ok or Err, never a panic; an Ok result re-encodes to an equal sdk value.

dependencies: polaris_sdk::ids::{Cid, FrameId, SessionId, Seq, MicroUsd, TokenCount}

inputs.name: event
inputs.description: A decoded protobuf message, possibly hostile or incomplete.

output_type: Result<Event, ProtoError> (pb -> sdk) or pb::Event (sdk -> pb, infallible)
output_description: The validated sdk value, or a typed ProtoError naming the offending field.
